usedFor: Kanban Zone holds work cards, and Razorpay bills the customer with “Create Invoice” when a “Card Is Moved”.

bestTemplate.name: “Card Is Moved” in Kanban Zone, then “Create Invoice” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Moving a card signals a stage change, and the action creates an invoice with customer details and line items.

watchOut: “Card Is Moved” runs on every move, so “Create Invoice” could bill twice if a card moves back and forth.
